independent_regression.oracle: full BFS of every legal balanced-substring reverse+flip orbit

proof_equivalent_gate.invariant: Every legal balanced substring is a consecutive sequence of sibling subtrees under one parent, or a consecutive sequence of forest roots. reverse+flip maps that sequence to reversed order with every selected subtree mirrored; it never changes parent-child membership.
proof_equivalent_gate.completeness: Any adjacent sibling swap is realizable by reverse+flip on the two-subtree block followed by reverse+flip on each singleton subtree. Therefore arbitrary sibling/root permutations are reachable; recursive operations independently realize every ordered representation of each unordered rooted subtree.
proof_equivalent_gate.counting: For each unordered rooted-tree type, ways = multinomial(child type multiplicities) * product(child_type_ways^multiplicity). Apply the same multinomial at the forest-root level.

constraint_gate.complexity: O(N log N) deterministic map/sort implementation; O(N) tree storage
